name: Cosmo Robotics
summary: Cosmo Robotics Co., Ltd., established in Seoul, South Korea, in 2016, is a leading developer and manufacturer of advanced wearable robotic systems and medical exoskeletons. The company's diverse product portfolio is designed to assist with lower extremity gait rehabilitation, provide walking support for patients with weakened muscles or hemiplegia, and equip industrial workers with wearable suits to reduce physical strain. Among its specialized offerings are: Bambini Kids, a rehabilitation robot specifically for young children with mobility difficulties; Bambini Teens, a walking assist robot aiding older children and teenagers with gait impairments; EA2 PRO, a wearable robotic system built to enhance physical movement and improve gait patterns; EAM, a medical rehabilitation robot supporting lower limb gait therapy for individuals with neurological conditions; COSuit, a wearable suit crafted to assist with daily movements and minimize physical exertion; EA Personal, a walking assist device for individual home use to boost mobility; and the Industrial Suit COSaver Back, a wearable back-support solution aimed at reducing musculoskeletal load during lifting activities. The company, previously known as ExoAtlet Asia Co., Ltd., officially rebranded as COSMO ROBOTICS CO., Ltd. in 2024.
